_readme: The café set, its scene cards and the director's notes. 'places' and 'props' are the only targets and items an action may name; the game turns any other name into 'looks around'. A card's 'seats' are dealt to the cast in seat order at Scene Prep (4 seats for a cast of 4). Each scene draws one note: every actor gets 'note', except one random actor, who gets 'decoy'. A note applies during the scene's 3 turns. Notes are mostly physical, so the log shows who follows them. The 'what' text of a place is public, like the rest of the set and the card.

places.name: Counter
places.what: the coffee counter, with the espresso machine, the register and the tip jar

places.name: Placemat
places.what: a small table for one, set with a paper placemat

places.name: Forward
places.what: the front of the stage, facing the audience

places.name: Backward
places.what: the back of the stage, by the pastry case

places.name: Left
places.what: stage left, by the front door

places.name: Right
places.what: stage right, by the big window

cards.title: The Big Decision
cards.premise: Morning rush at the café. The line is out the door, and one customer cannot decide what to order.

seats.want: Take the order and clear the line before the rush gets worse.
Find the perfect drink, and hear every option at least twice.
Taste the croissant without anyone working out who you are.
Get someone to sign for a box of cups, right now.

cards.title: The Missing Tip Jar
cards.premise: Closing time. The tip jar has vanished from the Counter, and nobody may leave until it turns up.

seats.want: Get the tip jar back before closing.
Get a free refill and your usual seat at the Placemat.
Find one thing wrong with this café. Anything.
Play one song for tips, tip jar or no tip jar.

notes.note: Move to the Counter in your first turn, then never move anywhere else.
notes.decoy: Move to the Placemat in your first turn, then never move anywhere else.

notes.note: Grab a cup in your first turn and hold it all scene. Never throw it or give it away.
notes.decoy: Never touch a cup. Grab anything else you like.

notes.note: Give something to another actor every turn.
notes.decoy: Never give anything to anyone. Keep everything you grab.

notes.note: Throw something at least once, at the actor you trust least.
Say the word "espresso" every time you speak.
